title: Form fieldset ARIA roles prioritization and scope
content:
Purpose: This is an audit + grooming doc for how we treat form grouping (fieldset/legend) and ARIA roles in the Console component library. Goal is to: 1) produce a minimal, robust ARIA pattern that covers the most common Console forms (settings panels, create-resource wizards, quick-actions), 2) identify backlog items and acceptance criteria, and 3) capture wireframe changes and keyboard/voiceover notes for engineers and UX writers. Summary findings (high level): - Fieldset + legend semantics are currently implemented inconsistently across components (SettingsCard, ResourceForm, InlineConfig). Some places use role="group" without a visible legend; others use visually-hidden labels. - Screen reader behaviour diverges: VoiceOver on macOS reads legend text reliably when present; NVDA/JAWS behaviour depends on the grouping element used and focus order. - Many multi-field controls (toggle groups, radio groups with sub-controls) lack an explicit grouping announcement which causes users to miss contextual instructions. - Keyboard focus order is OK in linear forms but breaks in collapsible fieldsets (expanded/collapsed states not announced). Wireframe notes (proposed changes): - Wireframe 1: Settings panel (left nav + form) - Add visible legend for each logical group (e.g., "Inference options") when screen width > 900px. - For compact mode, legend becomes visually-hidden but remains in DOM as . - Add short helper text under legend (aria-describedby) for groups with non-obvious impact (billing/limits). - Wireframe 2: Create model endpoint wizard (stepper) - Step forms should wrap step-specific fields in a fieldset with aria-labelledby pointing to step heading id. - When step is collapsed (mini-step view), announce "Step 2 of 4: Model settings" on focus into group. Implement via aria-live region update when step expands. - Wireframe 3: Batch upload form (file controls + advanced options) - Nest advanced options inside
+ . Ensure summary has aria-controls referencing the advanced options region. - On keyboard expand/collapse, ensure focus is retained on the summary and screen reader announces state (use aria-expanded). Accessibility checklist (concrete): 1) Fieldset semantics - Required: Wrap logically related inputs in
+ whenever inputs are >= 2 AND they share instructions. - Acceptable alternative: use role="group" + aria-labelledby if visual constraints prevent using
. Add comment in component doc explaining tradeoffs. 2) Legends and labels - Legend must be concise (3–7 words) and match heading used elsewhere for discoverability. - Longer explanatory copy should be a separate paragraph under the legend with aria-describedby id referenced by fieldset/role=group. 3) Collapsible groups - Use
